candidate_practices.name: Name the changed target
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts change the attribution unit, inference target, recovery capability, or interpretation convention.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: specifying the changed question can distinguish a contribution without claiming priority.
candidate_practices.application: Replace 'a novel approach' with the previous target, new target, and operation enabling the change.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When the contribution improves performance on an unchanged task.

candidate_practices.name: Give each component a distinct job
candidate_practices.source_observation: The abstracts assign different mechanisms to different modeling or training obstacles.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: explicit jobs can make multiple contributions coherent without asserting independent causal effects.
candidate_practices.application: Rewrite component lists as 'obstacle → operation → intended consequence'; attach separate evidence only where available.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When component roles cannot be separated meaningfully.

support.specific_example: Grid mixtures address global/local modeling; spatial augmentation addresses domain variation.

contrasts.contrast: Transition decomposition redistributes complexity between coupled terms; independent component benefits would misdescribe this trade-off.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Whether component-specific evidence supports the assigned roles.

candidate_practices.name: Attach formal results to their conditions
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts connect mathematical claims to a projection, parameter restriction, activation requirement, or game regime.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: condition–consequence pairs reveal what a result actually licenses.
candidate_practices.application: State the mathematical object, qualifying condition, and consequence together; distinguish guarantees from experiments.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When only an empirical tendency is established.

contrasts.contrast: Reported low-loss trajectory behavior does not specify an unconditional convergence guarantee.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Formal assumptions, definitions, proof scope, and necessity versus sufficiency.

candidate_practices.name: Report efficiency at a defined quality point
candidate_practices.source_observation: The abstracts pair resource claims with quality outcomes and named settings, with varying specificity.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: paired quantities help readers identify what was saved and what performance was retained.
candidate_practices.application: State resource, reference, setting, and accompanying quality result; preserve maximum and range qualifiers.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When measurements use incompatible budgets or resource definitions.

contrasts.contrast: Speedup and degradation are qualitative; the extraction cannot support a numerical operating point.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Hardware, accounting boundaries, matched conditions, and total costs.

candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When added dimensions are irrelevant to the target capability.
